subject: [PATCH v4 7/8] mm/page_alloc: retry alloc_contig_pages() when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof function to retry allocation when the zonelist is rebuilt. This change addresses an issue where a gigantic hugetlb page can be allocated in ZONE_MOVABLE, even if it's not eligible for that zone. The patch checks the zonelist update sequence before using each zone and restarts the walk if it has changed. This ensures that the allocation process correctly handles changes to the zonelist during online operations.
